decisions.reason: Having survived the 2024 review, the cleaning soap now benefits from added sunk marketing and channel effort and is still easy to justify as part of the firm's full floor-care system, so management is likely to retain it unless sales clearly disappoint.
The maintenance oil line is closely tied to the firm's installed base of wood floors and its several models signal a visible commitment that management will be inclined to defend for another year.
The oak parquet line sits nearest the firm's core business and strategic direction, so after keeping it once already management is the most likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course.
